steps.step: clicking a worker opens its home: identity, purpose, at a glance, readiness, its assistant
Overview: editing the purpose saves a new version
Knowledge & instructions: entries with their source, add one, remove one (confirmed), see what a task receives
Tools & access: the person's accounts kept apart from what this worker has
Assistant pane: a message runs a real assistant conversation; its change shows as a card with Undo; the home refreshes
History: the pending change can be approved; versions list who changed what; Undo restores the version before the skill
Activity lists the assistant conversation; New task opens the composer with this worker chosen
